A new analysis in Science of DNA from Chilean mummies has revealed the earliest known strain of ancient smallpox from the Americas. 

The findings offer the clearest genetic evidence yet that European colonization brought this disease to the New World. 

Learn more: https://scim.ag/4w3Sl5U

Europe's forests are losing more biomass than previously thought.

A study published in @natgeosci.nature.com and supported by ESA's Climate Change Initiative found that biomass losses per hectare have increased by 46% since 2018, with drought and insect outbreaks driving increasingly severe losses.
